result.rule: Several unconditional outgoing flows from one activity can all proceed. Use a gateway when the description requires a decision or synchronization.
Do not merge separately described actions into one task or split one stated action without a process reason. Preserve described dependencies.
Distinguish message tasks from message events: a task models performed work; an event models a message occurrence affecting flow.
Use gateways to control divergence and convergence, never to represent work. Identify exclusive, inclusive, parallel, event-driven or complex behavior.
Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
Use lanes to partition one process by a stated role, department, system or responsibility; lanes are not separate processes.

args.text: When a process description states alternative ways of carrying out an action, model them as exclusive branches with a distinct task for each alternative, rather than as one combined task.

trace.reason: Check whether an error-driven guideline already covers modeling explicitly described alternatives.

result.rule: When the description distinguishes different actions or process states involving the same participant or subject at different stages: Label each BPMN activity and outcome to reflect the specific action or state described at that stage; do not substitute a different action or an unsupported outcome.
When the description states a meaningful condition or outcome that starts or ends the process: Label the corresponding start or end event with that condition or outcome rather than a generic label.

When the description states a process start and an ordered sequence of activities or transitions between phases: Model the stated start, include each distinct activity, and connect the flow nodes with sequence flows in the described order, including transitions between phases.

When the description identifies multiple required activities within a phase, requires all of them before that phase can end, and specifies no order among them: Model the activities as parallel branches synchronized by a parallel gateway.
